S18 -> g193_budget_floor B1: the D48 floor is deleted, the clause reverts to bare D47 and the budget deletes core sections
S19 -> g193_budget_floor B3: the optional term is neutralised, D47 is undone and the prehab rail pays for the core finisher again
note: Literally DELETING the term ('if(s && ((s.items||[]).length>1)) return false;') was tried first and is a behavioural no-op across the whole 2940 day-build sweep: stripping protection from NON-optional multi-item sections changes nothing, because on an over-budget day the trim loop resolves at rank 3 or 2 and never descends to the protected work. A no-op mutation is a mutation defect, not a gate defect (V185), so the same term is broken the other way instead. The inverted form (!s.optional) was measured too and produces byte-identical output to this one.
